title: Basic MERGE upsert
body: MERGE staging into `silver.orders` on `order_id`. Update all columns when matched, insert when not.
solution:
MERGE INTO silver.orders AS t
USING staging.orders AS s
ON t.order_id = s.order_id
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET *
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT *

title: MERGE with DELETE (CDC)
body: Apply CDC: delete when `_op = 'D'`, else upsert.
solution:
MERGE INTO silver.orders AS t
USING cdc.orders AS s
ON t.order_id = s.order_id
WHEN MATCHED AND s._op = 'D' THEN DELETE
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET *
WHEN NOT MATCHED AND s._op <> 'D' THEN INSERT *

title: Dedupe before MERGE
body: Write SQL to keep latest row per `customer_id` from staging using `updated_at`.
solution:
MERGE INTO silver.customers AS t
USING (
  SELECT * FROM (
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY updated_at DESC) rn
    FROM staging.customers
  ) WHERE rn = 1
) AS s
ON t.customer_id = s.customer_id
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET *
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT *

title: Time travel audit
body: Compare row counts between current table and version 3.
solution:
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM silver.orders) AS current_cnt,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM silver.orders VERSION AS OF 3) AS v3_cnt

title: OPTIMIZE with Z-ORDER
body: Compact `gold.events` and Z-ORDER by `event_date`, `region`.
solution:
OPTIMIZE gold.events
ZORDER BY (event_date, region)

title: VACUUM with retention
body: Remove orphaned files older than 7 days from `silver.orders`.
solution: VACUUM silver.orders RETAIN 168 HOURS

title: Describe table detail
body: Write query to inspect file count and size for a Delta table.
solution: DESCRIBE DETAIL silver.orders

title: Enable Change Data Feed
body: Enable CDF on existing Delta table `silver.orders`.
solution:
ALTER TABLE silver.orders
SET TBLPROPERTIES (delta.enableChangeDataFeed = true)

title: Read CDF changes
body: Select changes between versions 10 and 15 for `silver.orders`.
solution: SELECT * FROM table_changes('silver.orders', 10, 15)

title: Create partitioned Delta table
body: Create `bronze.events` partitioned by `ingest_date` from JSON path.
solution:
CREATE TABLE bronze.events
USING DELTA
PARTITIONED BY (ingest_date)
AS SELECT *, current_date() AS ingest_date
FROM json.`abfss://bronze@acct.dfs.core.windows.net/events/`

title: Grant read access
body: Grant SELECT on `prod.gold.revenue` to group `analysts`.
solution: GRANT SELECT ON TABLE prod.gold.revenue TO `analysts`

title: Create external table
body: Register Delta path as external table in UC.
solution:
CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE prod.bronze.raw_orders (
  order_id STRING,
  amount DOUBLE
)
USING DELTA
LOCATION 'abfss://bronze@acct.dfs.core.windows.net/raw_orders/'

title: Revoke modify access
body: Revoke MODIFY on silver PII table from interns group.
solution: REVOKE MODIFY ON TABLE prod.silver.customer_pii FROM `interns`

title: Show table lineage context
body: Display extended metadata for UC table.
solution: DESCRIBE TABLE EXTENDED prod.gold.orders

title: Create catalog and schema
body: Create `prod` catalog and `silver` schema.
solution:
CREATE CATALOG IF NOT EXISTS prod;
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS prod.silver;

title: Pass job parameter
body: In notebook, read widget `run_date` default today.
solution:
dbutils.widgets.text('run_date', '2024-01-01')
run_date = dbutils.widgets.get('run_date')

title: Conditional SQL task
body: Write SQL that fails job if bronze row count is zero today.
solution:
SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN raise_error('No bronze rows') END
FROM bronze.orders
WHERE ingest_date = current_date()

title: Incremental filter
body: Select rows from silver where `updated_at` > job watermark param.
solution:
SELECT * FROM silver.orders
WHERE updated_at > '${watermark}'

title: Bronze append stream
body: Append streaming JSON from path to Delta bronze with checkpoint.
solution:
spark.readStream.format('json')
  .load('abfss://bronze@.../landing/')
  .writeStream.format('delta')
  .option('checkpointLocation', 'abfss://.../_checkpoints/bronze_events')
  .trigger(availableNow=True)
  .start('abfss://bronze@.../delta/events')

title: Silver daily aggregate
body: Build gold daily revenue from silver orders.
solution:
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE gold.daily_revenue AS
SELECT order_date, region, SUM(amount) AS revenue
FROM silver.orders
WHERE order_status = 'completed'
GROUP BY order_date, region

title: Incremental gold MERGE
body: MERGE daily revenue summary into gold for today's date.
solution:
MERGE INTO gold.daily_revenue AS t
USING (
  SELECT order_date, region, SUM(amount) revenue
  FROM silver.orders
  WHERE order_date = current_date()
  GROUP BY 1, 2
) s
ON t.order_date = s.order_date AND t.region = s.region
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET revenue = s.revenue
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT *

title: Watermark control table
body: Update control table watermark after successful silver load.
solution:
MERGE INTO control.ingestion_state AS t
USING (SELECT 'orders' AS table_name, MAX(updated_at) AS wm FROM silver.orders) s
ON t.table_name = s.table_name
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET watermark = s.wm, updated_at = current_timestamp()
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT *

title: SCD Type 2 MERGE
body: When hash changes, close current row and insert new version.
solution:
MERGE INTO gold.dim_customer t
USING staging.customer s
ON t.customer_id = s.customer_id AND t.is_current = true
WHEN MATCHED AND t.row_hash <> s.row_hash THEN UPDATE SET end_date = current_date(), is_current = false
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (customer_id, attrs, start_date, end_date, is_current, row_hash)
VALUES (s.customer_id, s.attrs, current_date(), NULL, true, s.row_hash)

title: Schema evolution ALTER
body: Add nullable column `source_system` to bronze table.
solution: ALTER TABLE bronze.orders ADD COLUMN source_system STRING

title: Clone prod to dev
body: Create dev copy of gold orders for testing (shallow clone).
solution: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE dev.gold.orders SHALLOW CLONE prod.gold.orders
